description: NaAs₃H₂O₉ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent AsO₆ octahedra, corners with five AsO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-56°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.68 Å. There are three inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AsO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-60°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-1.77 Å. In the second As site, As is bonded to six O atoms to form AsO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AsO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-56°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-1.88 Å. In the third As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent AsO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-63°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.76 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.04 Å) and one longer (1.54 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one As, and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one As, and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two As atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent As atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two As atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one As, and one H atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two As atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two As atoms.
